title: Membership in the gate type language
statement: For a family of Boolean circuits, a gate type $t$ (or the absence of a gate type) and natural numbers $n,i$, the encoding of $n$ copies of $1$ followed by the binary representation of $i$ belongs to the type language for $t$ if and only if $i<\mathrm{size}(C_n)$ and vertex $i$ of $C_n$ has type $t$.
